## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor whose sample shape will be changed |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Tensor viewed with the requested sample shape |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shape | Target Shape | `shape` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated target sample dimensions; one dimension may be -1. Required. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: View is a tensor graph utility node; PipelineExecutor tensor shape execution is not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled and built as a resolved tensor view layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
